Sample.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/4] In this article we present data from three of these case studies.

Country.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/4] The data presented in this article comes from a U.K. study of 20 completed student suicides.

Population.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] Families/next of kin were asked for their consent to include their son's or daughter's case in the study.

Type.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/4] The data presented in this article comes from a U.K. study of 20 completed student suicides. The design and methods of the original study have been reported elsewhere (see Stanley et al., 2007).

Area.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/1] Initial analysis identified perfectionism (or similar constructs such as obsessive fear of failure, sensitivity to criticism, high self-criticism, etc.) as a factor which, from the perspective of those interviewed, contributed to the death to varying degrees from half (10) of the case studies.
